question: By how many billion dollars is the Li-ion battery recycling market projected to grow between 2025 and 2030, and at what annual growth rate?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text, strength FROM atoms WHERE lower(text) LIKE '%billion%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%2030%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%cagr%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%growth%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%market%'
